invented_facts: The Aurora 14 can reduce cloud workstation costs without losing capability; no cost or capability comparison is provided.
The cloud model requires data to stay in the office, and its monthly bill applies to every seat.
Engineers can access client files offline and process drawings and project files with on-device language models; the spec does not establish those workflows.
Email 1 omits the required 64 GB-or-more configuration when claiming support for models up to about 30 billion parameters.
Client drawings and project files never leave the device unless authorized; no such security guarantee is specified.
Storage is user-upgradeable; the spec confirms two M.2 slots but explicitly identifies only memory as user-upgradeable.
Ordering now positions the buyer for deployment when the new budget cycle opens; the sources do not establish that timing.
notes: All three emails have subjects and one explicit CTA, and they follow the requested sequence. Emails 1 and 2 exceed 120 words; unsupported cost, workflow, security and timing claims require more than light edits.
